Step:  
51 weeks = 357 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 358 days.  
1796 is a leap year (divisible by 4, and 1796 is after 1752 Gregorian rule applies).  
From 1795-02-25:  
Days remaining in 1795: 365 - (31+25) = 309 days (since Jan 31 + Feb 25 = 56 days passed, 365-56=309).  
358 - 309 = 49 days into 1796.  
Jan 1796: 31 days, so 49-31 = 18 days into February.  
1796-02-18.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1796-02-18
